## The Rule of the Masquerade (Doublethink)

In Ecotopia, authority never speaks in the language of cruelty. Just as in George Orwell's *1984*, the regime operates through **The Masquerade**: *every coercive act of state survival is framed as an act of maternal love, scientific purity, and civic restoration.*

* Nobody is starved — their calories are *lovingly optimized for biological equilibrium*.
* Nobody is interrogated — their uncertainty is *held gently until it becomes still*.
* Nobody is executed — they receive the *privilege of being elemental upcycled into humus*.
* Nobody is forced into labor — they engage in *joyful physical devotion to the living grid*.

---

## The Ten Ministries of R.E.I.G.N.

<div class="clauses">

<div class="covenant-clause">
<strong>1. Miniplenty (Ministry of Ecological Bounty)</strong><br>
<em>Mandate:</em> Food rationing, caloric budgeting, and total elimination of packaging waste.<br>
<em>The Masquerade:</em> "Celebrating the beauty of self-imposed austerity and measured survival."<br>
<em>Station at De Warren:</em> The Dry-Pulse Dispensary & Gruel Kettle (Dining Hall).
</div>

<div class="covenant-clause">
<strong>2. Minilove (Ministry of Ecological Harmony)</strong><br>
<em>Mandate:</em> Biometric surveillance, corridor cameras, behavioral interrogation, and social thought-audits.<br>
<em>The Masquerade:</em> "Ensuring all souls exist in gentle, compliant harmony with Earth's carrying capacity."<br>
<em>Station at De Warren:</em> The Garage Induction Checkpoint & Holding Pen.
</div>

<div class="covenant-clause">
<strong>3. Minijoy (Ministry of Morale & State Celebration)</strong><br>
<em>Mandate:</em> Mandatory cheerfulness, eradication of pre-collapse nostalgia, and collective emotional pacing.<br>
<em>The Masquerade:</em> "Releasing pure human kinetic joy for the collective grid."<br>
<em>Station at De Warren:</em> The Dynamo Dancefloor & Apocalyptic Melodrama Stage.
</div>

<div class="covenant-clause">
<strong>4. Minirenewal (Ministry of Elemental Reclamation)</strong><br>
<em>Mandate:</em> Involuntary identity erasure, citizen upcycling, surname striking, and physical composting.<br>
<em>The Masquerade:</em> "The sublime honor of surrendering one's physical form back to the living soil."<br>
<em>Station at De Warren:</em> The Upcycling Portal & Suicide Carbon Booth.
</div>

<div class="covenant-clause">
<strong>5. Minilight (Ministry of Luminescence & Grid Harmony)</strong><br>
<em>Mandate:</em> Rolling blackouts, kilowatt rationing, and penal stationary bicycle conscription.<br>
<em>The Masquerade:</em> "Protecting our precious night sky and celebrating the spiritual depth of darkness."<br>
<em>Station at De Warren:</em> The Breaker Room & Battery Bank (Basement).
</div>

<div class="covenant-clause">
<strong>6. Miniflow (Ministry of Hydrological Purity)</strong><br>
<em>Mandate:</em> Moisture metering, graywater audits, and Peetopia biological fluid recovery.<br>
<em>The Masquerade:</em> "Honoring every sacred drop of Earth's circulating lifeblood."<br>
<em>Station at De Warren:</em> The Water Meter & Peetopia Restroom Audit Desk.
</div>

<div class="covenant-clause">
<strong>7. Minibreath (Ministry of Atmospheric Rectitude)</strong><br>
<em>Mandate:</em> Human breath quotas, respiratory rhythm pacing, and exhalation taxation.<br>
<em>The Masquerade:</em> "Harmonizing human exhalation with the delicate photosynthetic lung of the planet."<br>
<em>Station at De Warren:</em> The Corridor Carbon Sensor & Oxygen Rationing Chamber.
</div>

<div class="covenant-clause">
<strong>8. Minishelter (Ministry of Domestic Confinement)</strong><br>
<em>Mandate:</em> 15-minute perimeter lockdowns, room curfews, and cubic-meter density optimization.<br>
<em>The Masquerade:</em> "Maximizing thermal fellowship through cozy communal compression."<br>
<em>Station at De Warren:</em> The Corridor Checkpoints & Residential Perimeters.
</div>

<div class="covenant-clause">
<strong>9. Miniservice (Ministry of Restorative Labor)</strong><br>
<em>Mandate:</em> Penal dishwashing, waste sorting, and perpetual decontamination squads.<br>
<em>The Masquerade:</em> "Purifying the soul through the sacred, selfless rhythm of physical devotion."<br>
<em>Station at De Warren:</em> The Scullery ("Greenwashing") & Compost Shoveling Bay.
</div>

<div class="covenant-clause">
<strong>10. Minithrift (Ministry of Material Confiscation)</strong><br>
<em>Mandate:</em> Seizure of petroleum fabrics, plastic trinkets, and unauthorized possessions.<br>
<em>The Masquerade:</em> "Liberating citizens from the toxic burden of non-biodegradable vanity."<br>
<em>Station at De Warren:</em> The Contraband Surrender Locker & Upcycling Bench.
</div>

</div>
